preference_risk.rationale: This form can occur in Malaysian informal usage, creating some register-based competition with “tahun hadapan.”

response.rationale: “Tahun depan” is the ordinary Indonesian form, while “tahun hadapan” is a common Malaysian preference for the same calendar-year sense. The contrast is useful without implying exclusivity.
response.risk_rationale: Malaysian speakers may also use “tahun depan” in casual contexts, so the preference is not absolute.
response.shared_synonym_rationale: “Tahun depan” is also understood and used in Malaysia, especially informally, but “tahun hadapan” remains a credible Malaysian standard or preferred form for this cue.
